module_summary: Cache controller managing 16-line L1 cache with tag/data arrays, FSM-driven CPU and memory interfaces, multi-cycle refill and write operations.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: FSM state register controlling cache operation sequence through 5 states

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: Signals CPU request arrival; gates IDLE to LOOKUP transition

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Signals cache ready for new request when in IDLE state

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: Signals CPU response ready when FSM reaches RESPOND state

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Read data output to CPU from cache hit or memory refill

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledgment; completes REFILL and WRITE_MEM operations

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request signal; asserted in REFILL or WRITE_MEM states

anchors.name: tag_array
anchors.why: Stores tags for 16 cache lines; enables cache hit detection

anchors.name: data_array
anchors.why: Stores data for 16 cache lines; source for read hits

anchors.name: valid_bits
anchors.why: Flags valid cache lines; required for cache hit detection

anchors.name: addr_q
anchors.why: Holds CPU address across LOOKUP, WRITE_MEM, REFILL operations

anchors.name: wdata_q
anchors.why: Holds CPU write data until cache update or write-through completes

anchors.name: rdata_q
anchors.why: Holds read result from cache or memory before CPU output

anchors.name: we_q
anchors.why: Latched write-enable; steers read vs write operation path

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Data input from memory during cache line refill operations

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Address output to memory for fetch or write operations

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Data output to memory for cache line or result write

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Cache hit signal; steers LOOKUP to RESPOND or REFILL

groups.name: FSM_Controller
groups.description: 5-state FSM orchestrating cache operations: IDLE, LOOKUP, WRITE_MEM, REFILL, RESPOND

groups.name: CPU_Request_Interface
groups.description: CPU request handshake: valid, ready, write-enable, address, write-data

groups.name: CPU_Response_Interface
groups.description: CPU response: valid signal and read-data output; stall indication

groups.name: Cache_Storage
groups.description: 16-line cache with tag array, data array, and validity tracking

groups.name: Data_Pipeline
groups.description: Holding registers for address, write data, result; address extraction

groups.name: Hit_Detection
groups.description: Cache hit detection comparing valid bit and tag to select path

groups.name: Operation_Control
groups.description: Write-enable flag distinguishing read vs write operations

groups.name: Memory_Interface
groups.description: Memory request-response handshake and data paths for refill and write
